messages:
Maya P.: Kicking off a quick readout — Q2 field launch + PLG experiments coordination. Need alignment on top 3 sales targets and which playbooks we push first.
Jordan (Sales): Sales targets: focus on ARR from mid-market, target: 600k new ARR from pilot accounts. want a concise playbook by Monday.
Samir R.: For PLG experiments, we have 3 candidates: (1) first-30-days usage nudges, (2) prompt starter templates + inline examples, (3) low-friction dedicated trial billing. leaning to #1 + #2.
Liz H.: Can we map expected lift per experiment? even rough: 1 -> +8% activation, 2 -> +5% activation, 3 -> +12% conversion but higher ops.
Maya P.: Good. Priorities for enablement: field playbook (sales), PLG one-pager (growth), and engineer-facing runbook for rollout. Which owner for each? @Tessa?
Tessa (Enablement): I’ll own the field playbook. draft scope: positioning, objection handling, 2 demo scripts, 3 battlecards. ETA Wed EOD.
Jordan (Sales): Samir, can you provide 2 short case snippets we can use in the playbook? customer asks about latency/cost — include Redwood Dedicated options.
Samir R.: Done. attaching snippets in thread (will paste shortly). keep them short.
Olive - Growth Bot: Reminder: experiment window recommendation = 6 weeks with 2-week ramp, metric: 30-day active users + trial->paid conversion.
Maya P.: Rollout gating: must hit internal QA checklist + one pilot account success before wide push. QA checklist items: docs updated, pricing confirmed, support triage ready.
Liz H.: For launch comms: marketing will prepare 1 email to current trialers, 1 in-app banner, and 3 social posts. need hero metric for the copy — suggest "cut inference cost by up to 40% for typical workloads" (can we validate?)
Samir R.: 40% is within range for some configs; add qualifier: "in real-world evals, typical latency/cost improvements vs baseline". legal will review.
Jordan (Sales): Quick ask — can enablement include a short objection script for enterprise buyers around private deployment and compliance?
Tessa (Enablement): Yes. will include a two-line script + link to compliance page.
Maya P.: Decision log: Priority A = Field playbook + PLG starter templates; Priority B = billing trial flow; Priority C = expanded social campaign. Action owners: Tessa (playbook), Samir (PLG content), Liz (comm), Jordan (sales validation).
Jordan (Sales): I’ll run playbook with 3 reps this week and report back numbers Friday.
Olive - Growth Bot: Scheduled reminder: sync check Friday 14:00 UTC.
Maya P.: Thanks all — concise follow-ups please in thread. If you add blockers, flag with :warning:.
Samir R.: pasted two case snippets: "Acme Inc reduced inference spend 37% by batching + cache" and "BetaApp hit SLA with Dedicated + routing policy"
Tessa (Enablement): Noted. I’ll post first draft tomorrow and drop a short internal review doc link here.
Liz H.: Will prepare comms calendar and share by EOD Thursday.
Maya P.: ":rocket:"
